theorems.name: Submission.fiw_tb_tda_ps_translation_ball
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (u : Eucl n → ℝ) (Λ : ℝ≥0∞) (r : ℝ), Measurable u → (∀ h : Eucl n, ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal |u (x + h) - u x| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ‖h‖ * Λ) → ∫⁻ x, ∫⁻ y in closedBall x r, ENNReal.ofReal |u x - u y| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r * Λ * volume (closedBall (0 : Eucl n) r)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
